note: Groups: objects that share a group (a name from deck.next) are selected, moved, sized and aligned as one. Selecting one of them selects them all (viewChanged widens the selection with groupedSelection); Ungroup takes the name away; a pasted copy of a group is a group of its own.

rotateObjects.note: with: by: the selected objects but the locked ones turn a quarter, 90 to the right or -90 to the left

then.to: {{map(computed.objects, contains(state.board.selection, it.id) && !(it.locked ?? false) ? merge(it, { rotate: ((it.rotate ?? 0) + by + 360) % 360 }) : it)}}

flipObjects.note: with: axis: the selected objects but the locked ones are mirrored across (flipH) or upside down (flipV)

then.to: {{map(computed.objects, contains(state.board.selection, it.id) && !(it.locked ?? false) ? merge(it, parseJson('{' + json(axis) + ':' + json(!(it[axis] ?? false)) + '}')) : it)}}
